meta.documentTitle: MediQueue | Find your clinic and doctor
meta.documentDescription: MediQueue — discover the right clinics and doctors by symptom, city and date, and book with transparent prices.

footer.tagline: Turkey’s accredited clinic and doctor marketplace. Book with transparent prices.

account.title: Account settings
account.lead: You can delete your account yourself under the KVKK right to be forgotten. You do not need to give a reason.
account.retention: Deletion cannot be undone. Name, email, phone and health history are erased. Appointment dates and statuses are kept in anonymised form for legal retention. When payment records exist they are kept for accounting duties.
account.authLead: You need to sign in to manage or delete your account.

hero.title: Find the right clinic and doctor in seconds
hero.subtitle: Discover specialists by symptom, city and date. Transparent prices, real reviews and instant booking.

home.treatmentsDesc: The most requested categories — from dentistry to aesthetic surgery.
home.clinicsDesc: Accredited clinics with strong ratings and transparent prices.
home.doctorsDesc: Physicians highlighted by experience, rating and availability.
home.howTitle: Your appointment in three simple steps

how.step1Desc: Filter clinics and doctors by symptom, city and date — and see prices in the open.
how.step2Desc: Pick a slot and send a request in seconds. No deposit on MediQueue.
how.step3Desc: Attend the clinic, meet your specialist and pay on site.
how.headline: The simplest path to your treatment
how.lead: MediQueue simplifies everything from finding the right clinic to booking the visit.
how.v1Desc: Every clinic on the platform goes through a careful review.
how.v2Desc: No hidden fees. You see the full price before you book.
how.v3Desc: Only verified reviews from patients who completed treatment.
how.v4Desc: Create a request for free and pay at the clinic.
how.ctaBody: Thousands of accredited clinics and specialists are ready for you.

treatmentsPage.title: Treatments
treatmentsPage.lead: Choose a treatment to see matching clinics and doctors.

auth.loginLead: Sign in to manage your appointments.

auth.terms: By registering you accept the Terms of use

errors.network: Check your internet connection and try again.
errors.loginBad: Email or password is incorrect. Check your details and try again.
errors.session: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.forbidden: You don’t have permission for this action. Sign in with the right account.
errors.notFound: We couldn’t find that record. Refresh the list or try another option.

errors.dupAppt: You already have a request for this date. Check My appointments.
errors.doctorConflict: The physician is not available on that date. Try another day.
errors.conflict: This action conflicts with an existing record. Change the details and try again.
errors.validationEmpty: Something in the form is missing or invalid. Check and try again.
errors.validationOne: Check the {field} field and try again.
errors.rateLimit: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.server: That’s on our side — the team has been notified. Please try again.

chat.description: Ask about timing, airport transfer or documents here. Send the first message — the team replies on this secure channel.

clinicReviews.title: No reviews for this clinic yet
clinicReviews.description: After your treatment you can share how it went. The first honest review helps the next patient choose with confidence.

doctorReviews.description: You could be the first patient to share your experience. Reviews help other international patients choose with confidence.

clinicDoctors.description: You can still request an appointment with the clinic; the physician is confirmed during approval.

appointments.title: My appointments
appointments.lead: Track the requests you have submitted and their latest status here.
appointments.liveTip: Your appointments are loaded from the live API.

booking.noDeposit: Pay at the clinic — no deposit required
booking.unavailable: Online booking is not yet available for this clinic.
booking.clinicWillCall: The clinic will call shortly to confirm your appointment.

chat.demoTip: Messaging is running on demo data.

confirm.appointmentBody: Are you sure you want to cancel this appointment? This cannot be undone. The clinic will be notified and the slot may be offered to someone else.
confirm.accountBody: Are you sure you want to delete your account? We will not ask why. This cannot be undone. Personal data is erased or anonymised under KVKK, open appointments are cancelled, and sign-in is closed.
confirm.accountSecondBody: This cannot be undone. Your account will close for good. Appointment history is kept in anonymised form for legal retention; name, email, health history and message content are erased.
confirm.messageBody: Are you sure you want to delete this message? The other party will no longer see it. This cannot be undone.

permission.cameraId: We need camera or gallery access to verify your ID or medical photos. The image is attached only to this appointment.
permission.cameraChat: We need file access to attach an image or document to this conversation.
permission.locationBody: We need your location to show nearby clinics. It is not shared outside the map.
permission.locationOk: Location received — nearby clinics are highlighted.
permission.locationDenied: Location is blocked. You can turn it on in the browser site settings.
permission.notifyBody: We would like to send browser notifications for appointment updates and new messages. You can turn them off at any time.
permission.notifyDenied: Notifications are blocked in the browser. You can turn them on in site settings.
permission.notifyUnsupported: This browser does not support notifications.
